FAQ

Good to know.

Is Pathway free? +

Yes — your roadmap, requirement tracking, and AI advisor for one pathway are free. Paid plans add multi-school comparison and deeper application tools.

How is this different from Transferology or my advisor? +

Those tools tell you if a single class transfers. Pathway builds your entire roadmap, tracks your progress, and tells you what to do next — for your exact school and major.

Can the AI give me wrong information? +

Every answer is grounded in verified requirement data for your specific pathway, with a source and a last-verified date. If we're not sure, we say so and point you to a human advisor.

Which schools do you support? +

North Carolina only: its community colleges, the 16 UNC System universities, and 30 private colleges. Major-specific requirements are verified for a growing list of majors; elsewhere you'll see the general-education transfer guarantee, and we tell you which one you're looking at.
